headline: Names a Rochester, New York post office building after Specialist Theodore Matthew Glende.
what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service facility at 1335 Jefferson Road in Rochester, New York, as the "Specialist Theodore Matthew Glende Post Office." It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on November 26, 2014.
